Pull requests go to `develop`; `master` only takes releases. The maintainer reviews every change.

- [ ] Targets `develop`
- [ ] `gofmt -l .`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No real phone numbers, names, messages or keys, and no code copied from other WhatsApp clients

What does this change, and why?
